name: NightPad
notes: NightPad owns its release recipe (nightpad-v...-padmint.json). An Apple Silicon Mac builds a personal unsigned iPhone/iPad IPA and extracts the player's own Xbox Nightfire disc image into the NightPad game data folder that the app imports.

game_data_import.ios: ⋯ → Data & Saves → Game Data → Import Prepared Game Data…

steps: Install {file} on your iPhone or iPad, signed with your own Apple developer profile.
Updating? Install it over your current NightPad with the same signing to keep your codenames, saves and touch layout.

First time only: put the NightPad game data folder from {folder} on the device (Files, iCloud Drive or a USB drive). Open NightPad, choose ⋯ → Data & Saves → Game Data → Import Prepared Game Data… and pick that folder. Then choose ⋯ → Start Game.
